class Combinations {
public:
    vector<long long> z, z1, z2;
    long long mod;

    Combinations(long long N, long long mod) : mod(mod) {
        z.resize(N + 1);
        z1.resize(N + 1);
        z2.resize(N + 1);
        z[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) z[i] = (z[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        z2[0] = z2[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++)
            z2[i] = z2[(int)(mod % i)] * (mod - mod / i) % mod;
        z1[0] = z1[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++)
            z1[i] = (z2[i] * z1[i - 1]) % mod;
    }

    long long fac(long long n) {
        return z[(int)n];
    }

    long long invrsNum(long long n) {
        return z2[(int)n];
    }

    long long invrsFac(long long n) {

    long long ncr(long long N, long long R) {
        if (R < 0 || R > N) return 0;
        long long ans = ((z[(int)N] * z1[(int)R]) % mod * z1[(int)(N - R)]) % mod;
        return ans;
    }
};

class DisjointUnionSets {
public:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;

    DisjointUnionSets(int n) : n(n) {
        rank.resize(n);
        parent.resize(n);
        makeSet();
    }

    void makeSet() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
        }
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }

    void unionSets(int x, int y) {
        int xRoot = find(x), yRoot = find(y);
        if (xRoot == yRoot) return;
        if (rank[xRoot] < rank[yRoot])
            parent[xRoot] = yRoot;
        else if (rank[yRoot] < rank[xRoot])
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
        else {
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
            rank[xRoot] = rank[xRoot] + 1;
        }
    }
};

vector<int> KMP(string str) {
    int n = str.length();
    vector<int> kmp(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = kmp[i - 1];
        while (j > 0 && str[i] != str[j]) {
            j = kmp[j - 1];
        }
        if (str[i] == str[j]) j++;
        kmp[i] = j;
    }
    return kmp;
}

class SparseTable {
private:
    vector<vector<long long>> st;
    vector<int> log;

public:
    SparseTable(vector<long long>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        st.assign(n, vector<long long>(25, 0));
        log.resize(n + 2, 0);
        build_log(n + 1);
        build(arr);
    }

    void build(vector<long long>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
                int r = i + (1 << j) - 1;
                if (r >= n) break;
                if (j == 0) st[i][j] = arr[i];
                else st[i][j] = min(st[i][j - 1], st[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        if (a == 0) return b;
        return gcd(b % a, a);
    }

    long long query(int l, int r) {
        int w = r - l + 1;
        int power = log[w];
        return min(st[l][power], st[r - (1 << power) + 1][power]);
    }

    void build_log(int n) {
        log[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            log[i] = 1 + log[i / 2];
        }
    }
};
